name: htop
description: A more comfortable version of top: colored bars for each core and for memory, scrolling, mouse selection, process tree. The function keys are listed at the bottom of the screen: F3 searches, F4 filters, F5 shows the tree, F6 sorts, F9 sends a signal, F10 or q quits. htop is not always installed by default (sudo apt install htop).

options.description: Refresh interval, in tenths of a second.
Column to sort by at startup (PERCENT_CPU, PERCENT_MEM…).
Starts in tree view (parents and children).

examples.explanation: Only the processes of the user esprit.
Shows the process tree straight away.
Sorts by memory use from the start.
